# X.page

X.page makes businesses citable by AI agents.

## Offer
Scan a business website for AI-agent discoverability and publish a verified structured business identity page.

## Product paths
- Homepage: https://x.page/
- Scanner: https://x.page/scan
- Agent pages: https://x.page/p/{domain}
